dataset_obj.open_run: Open the run that produced it →
dataset_obj.lineage_note: This dataset was written by a workflow run; the run is an object you can open, not a string in a description.

dataset_obj.uploaded_input: Uploaded input — no upstream workflow produced this dataset.

dataset_obj.no_versions: Version history is not available yet — only the current dataset is recorded.

msg.file_not_found: The file could not be found.
msg.unprofilable: This file type cannot be read here ({{name}}); only its size is reported.
msg.parse_failed: The file could not be parsed; it may be malformed or in a different format than its name suggests.
msg.unresolvable_ref: The dataset reference could not be resolved to a readable file.
msg.structured_too_large: Structural validation is limited to files under 2 million characters; download the file for a complete check.
msg.structured_only: Valid {{format}} syntax ({{root}} root). Only the structure was checked; scientific quality has not been assessed.
msg.fastq_reads: Reads scanned: {{reads}}; mean read length {{mean_len}} bp.
msg.fastq_mean_quality: Mean base quality: Phred {{q}} (sampled; Phred 20 = 1 error in 100 bases, 30 = 1 in 1,000).
msg.fastq_single_file: Profiled on its own: whether it has a read-2 mate was not checked.
msg.fastq_single_end_effect: single-end pipeline suggested (override if a paired mate exists)
msg.fastq_low_quality: Mean base quality Phred {{q}} is below 20 (more than 1 error in 100 bases) — consider trimming.
msg.fastq_no_records: No FASTQ records could be parsed — the file may be malformed.
msg.vcf_no_variants: No variant records were found (header only).
msg.vcf_sized_effect: variant annotation and filtering plan sized accordingly
msg.no_columns: No columns could be parsed from the table.
msg.header_only: A header is present but there are no data rows.
msg.high_missing: Columns with at least {{pct}}% missing values: {{columns}}.
msg.label_spellings: Two spellings of the same label: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}”.
msg.minority_class: Class “{{label}}” is only {{pct}}% of rows — consider a balanced sampler.
msg.effective_n_imbalance: Effective N ({{n}}) is far below the row count ({{rows}}) — bounded by the minority class under strong imbalance.
msg.effective_n_dedup: Effective N ({{n}}) is below the row count ({{rows}}) — duplicate rows ({{duplicates}}) reduce the independent samples.
msg.label_free_text: Column “{{column}}” looks like a label, but its distinct values ({{distinct}}) make it free text, not a class target.
msg.table_clean: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; groups are balanced, no column gives the group away, and no column is constant.
msg.profiled_subset: Statistics were computed on the first {{profiled}} of {{rows}} rows.
msg.leaked_id: Column “{{column}}” differs in almost every row yet matches the groups exactly — it probably encodes the group (e.g. a sample ID containing the condition); do not use it as a predictor.
msg.leaked_feature: Column “{{column}}” matches the groups in {{pct}}% of rows — it may encode the group itself; check it before using it in a model.
msg.drop_leaky_column_effect: leave “{{column}}” out of any model that predicts the group
msg.batch_confound: “{{column}}” (batch) lines up almost exactly with the groups, so batch and condition effects cannot be separated — a design problem for differential analysis.
msg.batch_covariate_effect: include “{{column}}” in the design (e.g. as a covariate) for differential analysis
msg.split_overlap: Feature rows that appear in more than one split: {{count}} — train/test overlap.
msg.dedup_splits_effect: de-duplicate rows across splits before evaluation
msg.nested_tables: Column “{{column}}” holds embedded tables: {{tables}}; rows per table: median {{median_rows}}, largest {{max_rows}}; columns per table: median {{median_cols}}.
msg.nested_row_cap: {{pct}}% of the tables in column “{{column}}” have the maximum row count ({{max_rows}}), far more than any other size: they were probably cut off when extracted. Check the extraction before analysing them.
msg.nested_blank_cells: {{pct}}% of the cells in the tables of column “{{column}}” are blank — typical of merged or multi-line cells in extracted tables; join continuation rows before analysis.
msg.columns_generated: No header row detected (line 1 holds data values); columns are named column_1, column_2, …
msg.columns_spec: {{format}} files have no header row; column names follow the {{format}} specification: {{columns}}.
msg.columns_comment: Column names taken from the file's last “#” comment line: {{columns}}.
msg.intervals_unstranded: No strand column: the intervals are treated as unstranded.
msg.annotation_features: Feature lines: {{features}}; comment lines: {{comments}}; attribute keys ({{count}}): {{attributes}}.
msg.mtx_bad_header: Not a readable Matrix Market file: the %%MatrixMarket banner or the size line is missing.
msg.mtx_dimensions: Sparse matrix of {{field}} values; {{density}}% of its cells hold a stored entry.
msg.mtx_orientation: Matrix Market files carry no row or column names: pair this matrix with its features and barcodes files (10x: rows are features, columns are cells).
msg.format_metadata_only: {{format}} metadata was read; the data values themselves have not been analysed.
msg.format_identified: Identified as {{format}} ({{size}}); its contents are not analysed here.
msg.format_metadata_skipped: {{format}} metadata was not read: the file ({{size}}) is above the {{cap}} limit for reading during upload.
msg.format_header_unreadable: The {{format}} header could not be read; the file may be truncated or malformed.
msg.fasta_sequences: Sequences: {{sequences}}; {{total}} {{unit}} in total; length mean {{mean}}, min {{min}}, max {{max}}, N50 {{n50}} (half of all bases lie in sequences at least this long).
msg.anndata_shape: Rows of the matrix X are cells (obs); its columns are genes or features (var).
msg.loom_shape: Rows of the matrix are genes; its columns are cells (the loom layout, transposed relative to AnnData).
msg.alignment_references: Total length of the reference sequences in the header: {{length}} bp.
msg.alignment_not_coordinate_sorted: Sort order is {{order_words}}, not by coordinate: sort the file before indexing or variant calling.
msg.alignment_no_read_groups: No read groups (@RG) in the header: GATK and most variant callers require them.
msg.spreadsheet_convert: Spreadsheets are not checked cell by cell: export the sheet to CSV to get the table checks.
msg.fasta_high_n: {{pct}}% of bases are N (unknown): gaps or a low-quality assembly.
msg.fasta_orphan_lines: Sequence lines before the first “>” header, which were ignored: {{count}}.
msg.fasta_profiled_subset: Statistics cover the first {{mb}} MB of the file.
msg.fastq_paired_mate: Read {{read}} of sample {{sample}}; its mate {{mate}} is in the same folder.
msg.fastq_paired_end: Both reads of the pair present
msg.fastq_mate_missing: Read {{read}} of sample {{sample}}; no read-{{missing}} mate is in this folder.
msg.fastq_orphan_single_end_effect: single-end for sample {{sample}} until the mate is added
msg.fastq_single_end_named: No read-1/read-2 naming and no mate in this folder.
msg.tenx_member_headerless: Part of the 10x matrix {{matrix}} in this folder: header-less by the 10x specification, so line 1 is data.
msg.mtx_tenx_set: 10x matrix: rows are the features in {{features}}, columns are the cells in {{barcodes}} (same folder).
msg.folder_fastq_pairs: Paired samples detected from the {{pattern}} file naming: {{pairs}}.
msg.folder_fastq_orphan: {{name}} has no {{missing}} mate in this folder — sample {{sample}} would run single-end.
msg.folder_fastq_single_end: No read-1/read-2 naming: every FASTQ file ({{n}} in all) is a single-end sample.
msg.folder_fastq_mixed_layout: The folder mixes paired samples ({{pairs}}) and unpaired samples ({{unpaired}}); most pipelines expect one layout per run.
msg.folder_fastq_sample_runs: Sample {{sample}} appears in {{n}} rows (lanes or runs); nf-core pipelines merge rows of the same sample.
msg.folder_samplesheet: nf-core samplesheet ready ({{layout}}; sample, fastq_1, fastq_2); rows: {{rows}}. Paths are relative to the {{path_base}}.
msg.folder_tenx_recognised: 10x Genomics matrix ({{version}}) in {{dir}}: {{cells}} cells × {{genes}} genes, {{nnz}} non-zero entries.
msg.folder_tenx_recognised_nodims: 10x Genomics matrix ({{version}}) in {{dir}}; its size could not be read.
msg.folder_tenx_mtx_unreadable: {{name}} has no readable Matrix Market size line.
msg.folder_tenx_incomplete: The 10x matrix in {{dir}} is missing its {{missing}} file.
msg.folder_tenx_headerless: features.tsv / genes.tsv and barcodes.tsv have no header row by the 10x specification — line 1 is data.
msg.name_content_mismatch: Named as {{named}}, but the content is {{detected}} — it is shown and checked as {{detected}}.
msg.compressed_unreadable: The compressed file could not be decompressed: it is corrupt or not actually compressed.
msg.compressed_corrupt: The compressed data is corrupt partway through, so the file cannot be read reliably.
msg.compressed_truncated: The compressed file ends early (truncated): only the readable part was checked.
msg.nul_bytes: Lines with NUL bytes, which were ignored: {{lines}}.
msg.jsonl_skipped_lines: Lines that are not valid JSON were skipped: {{count}}.
msg.ragged_rows: Rows whose number of fields differs from the header's ({{expected}}): {{count}}.
msg.table_clean_unlabelled: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; no constant columns or missing-value problems. No group column (e.g. condition) was found, so group sizes were not checked.
msg.few_data_rows: Too few data rows for the column and label checks (rows: {{rows}}).
msg.blank_content: The file holds only blank lines.
msg.comment_lines_skipped: Comment lines before the table were skipped: {{count}}.
msg.fastq_malformed_records: Records that do not follow the four-line FASTQ layout (or whose quality line differs in length from the sequence): {{count}} of {{checked}} checked.
msg.fastq_index_read: Index read ({{read}}) of sample {{sample}}: it holds the sample barcodes, not biological reads, and is used only for demultiplexing.
msg.vcf_malformed_lines: Data lines with fewer than 8 tab-separated columns: {{count}}.
msg.folder_fastq_index_reads: Index-read files set aside ({{n}}): {{names}}. They hold sample barcodes for demultiplexing, so they are not samples of their own.
msg.text_encoding_legacy: The file is not UTF-8 text; it was read as {{encoding}}. Check that accented or non-Latin characters display correctly — tools that expect UTF-8 may misread them.
msg.text_encoding_replaced: Byte sequences that are not valid UTF-8 were replaced with “�”: {{count}}.
msg.duplicate_column_names: Column names used more than once: {{columns}}. Tools that look columns up by name keep only one of them or rename them.
msg.structure_experimental: Experimental structure ({{method}}): the B-factor column holds atomic displacement, not prediction confidence.
msg.structure_predicted: Predicted model ({{predictor}}), not an experimental structure: the B-factor column holds the predictor's per-residue confidence (pLDDT for AlphaFold-type models).
msg.constant_columns: Constant columns (the same value in every row): {{columns}}.
msg.anndata_no_layers: No layers: the expression values are in X only.
msg.label_few_rows: “{{column}}” looks like the group column, but with {{rows}} rows (at least {{min_rows}} needed) group balance was not assessed and columns were not screened for predicting the group; batch and donor columns were still checked against the groups.
msg.label_no_features: Column “{{column}}” looks like a group column, but the other columns are identifiers or annotation, so there is nothing to compare between the groups.
msg.table_clean_label_unchecked: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; no constant columns or missing-value problems.
msg.spreadsheet_preview: Preview of sheet “{{sheet}}”: its first rows (rows shown: {{rows}}).
msg.folder_samplesheet_single_end: Unpaired files go to a separate single-end samplesheet ({{filename}}, rows: {{rows}}).
msg.group_nested: Each value of “{{column}}” occurs in only one group of “{{label}}”, so {{column}} and {{label}} effects cannot be separated — a confounded design; dropping the column does not fix it.
msg.sample_groups_from_names: Sample columns form groups by name: {{groups}}.
msg.spreadsheet_preview_sheets: Sheets ({{count}}): {{sheets}}; the preview shows the first rows of “{{sheet}}” (rows shown: {{rows}}).

perception.gloss_effective_n: Effective N: how many independent samples the data is really worth once duplicate rows and class imbalance are accounted for — usually fewer than the row count.
perception.gloss_leakage: Leakage: a column carries information about the outcome that would not be available at prediction time, so a model trained on it looks better than it really is.
perception.gloss_keys: Every key in the file, counting nested objects at every depth.
perception.gloss_values: Every value in the file (numbers, text, true/false, null), at every depth.
perception.near_constant_expected_few_rows: Expected with this few rows — not flagged.
perception.near_constant_expected_record_metadata: The same value in every record is per-record metadata — not flagged.

workflow_not_found.cause: The workflow itself could not be loaded on the server — the pipeline path it was given does not exist or is unavailable.

bad_contrast.next_named: Make the contrast variable match a column that exists in the sample sheet (add the column, or fix its name/spelling), then run again.

missing_column.cause_named: The analysis expected a column '{{column}}' that is not in your input table.
missing_column.next_named: Add the '{{column}}' column to your input (or correct the column name in the parameter that selects it), then run again.

too_few_rows.cause_named: The input table has only {{rows}} usable row(s), too few for {{folds}}-fold cross-validation — it does not look like a training table (one row per sample with feature columns and a label).
too_few_rows.next_named: Pick a dataset with one row per sample (at least a few dozen rows), or lower the number of folds / use a holdout split, then train again.

empty_input.cause: One of the input files is empty — there was no data for the step to process.
empty_input.cause_named: The input file {{file}} is empty — there was no data for the step to process.
empty_input.next: Confirm the upload/transfer completed and the file actually contains data, replace the empty input, then run again.
empty_input.next_named: Confirm the upload/transfer completed and the file actually contains data, replace the empty input, then run again.

out_of_memory.cause: The step{{step}} ran out of memory (or was killed for exceeding its resource limit){{exit}}.
out_of_memory.next: Re-run with a larger memory / instance size for that step, or reduce the input size (subset / downsample) so it fits.

container_tool.cause: A tool or container the step{{step}} needs was not available (missing command or image).
container_tool.next: This is usually an environment issue on our side — report it to BioMate; we will check the container/tool image for that step. Re-running as-is will not help until it is fixed.

missing_input_file.cause: An input file the pipeline needs could not be found at the path it was given.
missing_input_file.cause_named: An input the pipeline needs could not be found: {{file}}.
missing_input_file.next: Check that the file parameter points to a file that exists and is still accessible (re-upload or fix the path), then run again.
missing_input_file.next_named: Check that the file parameter points to a file that exists and is still accessible (re-upload or fix the path), then run again.
